events.summary: Phyrexia poisons Serra's Realm and engineers its collapse; generations later the angels take revenge.
events.quote: A thousand years ago, Phyrexia poisoned Serra's Realm and engineered its collapse.

events.summary: Jhoira finds an ally in the Peregrine Dynamo, not just spare parts.
events.quote: Jhoira stumbled upon an ally, not just a good source of spare parts.

events.summary: Tobias spends decades tormenting pirates and then decades dead beneath the sea.
events.quote: Tobias spent decades tormenting pirates on the open sea and decades more dancing lifelessly beneath it.

events.summary: Anafenza is martyred for worshipping her ancestors and now walks among them.
events.quote: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.

events.summary: Centuries ago, Urza's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.
events.quote: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

events.summary: Odric resists a vampire's curse but is doomed to become a monster himself.
events.quote: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength.

events.summary: Teysa convenes the Obzedat's meeting and Kaya ends it.
events.quote: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.

events.summary: O-Kagachi's behest starts the Kami War to regain That Which Was Taken.
events.quote: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

events.summary: Darigaaz gives his life defending Dominaria from self-styled gods.
events.quote: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi; Jace doubts it given last time.
events.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin.

events.summary: Angrath calls dinosaurs dragons and the name sticks among pirates.
events.quote: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

events.summary: 891 samurai die in a single battle at Shizo, turning it into a haunted moor.
events.quote: After 891 samurai died in a single battle on its grasses, it became a haunted moor.

relations.quote: "As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations." —Ajani Goldmane

relations.note: His destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side
relations.quote: My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side.

relations.quote: "I will be your most demanding master, Liliana."
